text:
Ava (People Ops): Rooftop BBQ + board games next Friday (Jun 12) 6–9pm — thinking sunset vibes + short games. React :beer: = coming, :shrug: = maybe, :x: = can't. Potluck sign-up: https://tinyurl.com/rw-bbq-potsheet (add dish + dietary notes). If it rains we'll move to 6th-floor conf room. Remote peeps — we'll stream Jackbox from 7:30 if people want to join online.
Kevin T.: :beer: +1 — I can bring burgers (classic & turkey).
Jen W.: :beer: vegetarian here, I can bring grilled veggies and a salad. Any vegans?
Sam R.: :shrug: tentative, got a late client call but I'll try to hop over after.
Maria L.: Quick Q — is there a budget for drinks/snacks or should folks bring?
Ava (People Ops): We have a small budget (~$200) for shared drinks/snacks, team leads can expense via Ops card. Put receipts in #finance and tag me.
Liam H.: Can someone add GF buns to the list? Also, can we get a couple of folding tables and a power strip for phones?
Sophia P.: I can bring disposable plates/cutlery and a big cooler. Also have a power strip to spare.
Kevin T.: I'll add GF buns to the sheet. Also voting for Codenames + Sushi Go — quick rounds.
Jen W.: +1 to short games. If we do Catan it eats time.
Sam R.: For remote — Jackbox is great. We can do a hybrid setup: speakerphone on a tripod and laptop for stream.
Ava (People Ops): Nice — thanks. If you're bringing a guest, please note +1 column on the sheet. Guests welcome but keep it to one.
ops-bot: calendar event created: Rooftop BBQ + Games — Jun 12 18:00 (link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1761801234).
Maria L.: Heads up — I'm allergic to shellfish, will add to the dietary column.
Liam H.: Volunteers to pick up ice? I'll do it if someone can cover gas money.
Sophia P.: I'll Venmo you for gas.
Kevin T.: Also adding a short cleanup crew sign-up at the bottom of the sheet. Two people for 30 mins and we're done.
Ava (People Ops): Perfect. I'll send a reminder early next week and lock RSVPs on Thursday so we can order extras. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
